statement: On the LEADER->FOLLOWER edge, a partition replica rolls back its open ACTIVE (never-PREPARED) participant transaction via the shipped crash-equivalent follower-heal sequence (isStuckTransactionHealPermitted + committedIndex guard), so a ledger self-move can never strand a wedged BEGIN IMMEDIATE past the step-down (collapsing the ~60-78s durability-unfit freeze to the demotion edge). PREPARED/voted transactions are NEVER rolled back by this path. The apply-dedup clear runs only when a rollback actually fired. Sealed doneWhen: a deterministic test reproduces the stranded-BEGIN-across-step-down wedge RED (an ACTIVE participant BEGIN opened on a leader survives past the leadership handoff and freezes durability) and the on-follower-edge rollback clears it GREEN with red-on-revert; a PREPARED participant is asserted NOT rolled back by the edge; and the dedup-clear-only-on-actual-rollback guard holds across repeated step-down edges.
